title: How Late Does a Flight Have to Be for Compensation?
description: Under EU261 you can claim when you reach your final destination 3 hours or more late. Compensation is €250 to €600 per passenger, depending on distance. #flightdelay #eu261 #travelrights
alt: Dark pin with a clock: how late a flight must be before you are owed compensation

title: Book These 4 Things Before Your Trip to Rome
description: Timed tickets for the Colosseum and Roman Forum, Vatican Museums entry (closed most Sundays), the Borghese Gallery and a central stay with free cancellation. #romeitaly #italytrip #travelplanning

title: Flying a US Airline? Are You Covered by EU261?
description: Flights leaving the EU are covered on any airline, including Delta, United and American. Flights into the EU are covered only on EU-based airlines. #eu261 #flightcompensation #traveltips
alt: Cream pin explaining which flights on US airlines are covered by EU261

title: Rome's New Tourist Fees for 2026
description: Going down to the Trevi Fountain basin now costs €2 and the Pantheon is €7. Here's what's still free and a 3-day itinerary that plans around the new fees. #rome2026 #romeitaly #europetravel
